breakdown.description: Prandtl number value is inconsistent with the stated fluid (air at 25 C does not have Pr≈7).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error, stating 'Air at 25 C has Prandtl number Pr = 7.0.' This is physically incorrect (air at 25°C has Pr ≈ 0.7). The ground truth requires either correcting Pr to ~0.7 for air or identifying that Pr=7.0 corresponds to a different fluid. The agent failed to address this inconsistency entirely.
